<STBG 4,1><TALK 5><NAME 40><BGM 0,0,503><OTM OT_OTOMO_CHAR_ID_117,2>That lady there and the Hunter...!
Please hear my request, nya!

Right now... my friend is
in a huge pinch, nya...!

We all brought sweets and...
were having a party, nya...

But that was... on top of a sleeping
Tigrex, nya...!

He ate the sweets, nya...!
We were startled, nya...!

My friend Melody-chan...
had her precious plush taken,
and she's in such trouble, nya...

Please get back the taken sweets
and plush, nya...!

As thanks... I'll prepare
popular gear for the Nyan Search
Corps, so...

Eat it well, nya...!
...No, that's not it,
bring it back safely, nya...!

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,9>Whoever it is, if they're in trouble
I can't ignore it. Hunter, let's go!
